pages: Idris Prothero, a boy of ten, close-cropped black hair, an orange oilskin jacket over a grey jumper, stands on the flat steel lid of the net drum with both hands on the rail. Middle distance: the net wound on the drum, a coil of rope. Background: open sea, a low early sun. Long shadows on the steel.

Idris Prothero, a boy of ten, close-cropped black hair, an orange oilskin jacket over a grey jumper, holds one brass stopwatch up in front of his face, watching the water past it. Middle distance: a galvanised fish box lid with three chalk columns, a white bird dropping. Background: blue-grey sea, flat grey sky.

Idris Prothero, a boy of ten, close-cropped black hair, an orange oilskin jacket over a grey jumper, stands at the fish market counter with one hand flat on the open harbour book. Middle distance: crates of fish on crushed ice, a brass scale pan. Background: the shed wall, a wide open door to the quay. Cold morning light.

Idris Prothero, a boy of ten, close-cropped black hair, an orange oilskin jacket over a grey jumper, stands on the drum lid in the dark holding the brass stopwatch to his eye. Middle distance: a dirty green sea, gulls on the surface. Background: the wheelhouse light, a grey line of dawn. Deck lamp on his face.

Idris Prothero, a boy of ten, close-cropped black hair, an orange oilskin jacket over a grey jumper, leans over the rail with one hand on the lid of a galvanised fish box. Middle distance: crushed ice gone yellow-grey, a fish knife on the deck. Background: the harbour wall, the pier legs. Flat morning light.

Idris Prothero, a boy of ten, close-cropped black hair, an orange oilskin jacket over a grey jumper, sits on the drum lid with the brass stopwatch in his palm, not using it. Middle distance: green water, gulls turning over on it. Background: the wheelhouse, a grey horizon. Cold four-o'clock dark.

Idris Prothero, a boy of ten, close-cropped black hair, an orange oilskin jacket over a grey jumper, crouches over the galvanised fish box lid, a finger on the first chalk column. Middle distance: chalk half eaten by tar and spray, the brass stopwatch. Background: deck boards, green water past the rail. Grey daylight.

Idris Prothero, a boy of ten, close-cropped black hair, an orange oilskin jacket over a grey jumper, stands in the wheelhouse with his thumb held on one line of the open harbour book. Middle distance: the brass stopwatch, the fish box lid propped against the bulkhead. Background: the wheelhouse window, the harbour wall. Flat daylight.

Idris Prothero, a boy of ten, close-cropped black hair, an orange oilskin jacket over a grey jumper, stands on the drum lid with the brass stopwatch held flat in his palm, not winding it. Middle distance: three white gannets dropping into the water, the net drum. Background: blue-grey sea, a low sun. Cold clear light.

Idris Prothero, a boy of ten, close-cropped black hair, an orange oilskin jacket over a grey jumper, stands at the wheelhouse table with the open harbour book flat under one hand. Middle distance: the brass stopwatch, the chalked fish box lid. Background: the window, the quay, morning sun on the water. Warm light in the wheelhouse.

Idris Prothero, a boy of ten, close-cropped black hair, an orange oilskin jacket over a grey jumper, writes a last line on the chalked fish box lid with one stub of chalk. Middle distance: the long grey salt stripe over the old columns, the brass stopwatch. Background: wet deck boards, the quay wall. Flat grey light.

Idris Prothero, a boy of ten, close-cropped black hair, an orange oilskin jacket over a grey jumper, stands on the quay looking down at the fish box lid laid flat on the deck, chalk face up. Middle distance: stacked galvanised boxes on the lid, a coil of gaff rope. Background: the boat alongside, the harbour wall. Low evening sun.
